
{{alias}}( value )
    Converts a symbol alias or shorthand to a Vega symbol mark shape.

    If unable to resolve a shape, the function returns `null`.

    Parameters
    ----------
    value: string
        Symbol alias or shorthand.

    Returns
    -------
    out: string|null
        Symbol mark shape.

    Examples
    --------
    > var v = {{alias}}( 'o' )
    'circle'
    > v = {{alias}}( 'circle' )
    'circle'
    > v = {{alias}}( 'beep' )
    null

    See Also
    --------
